verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-portability feature, such as CSV or JSON export of subscribers, campaigns, or reports, or a full account export. The only related item is a general REST API that can 'pull data'. That is a developer building block for constructing an export, not an export capability, so it earns no credit. The import tools (Mailchimp importer, shop bulk-import) cover data coming in, not leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Push or pull data from our RESTful API.
